name: Flight Simulator Cape Town
summary:
Flight Simulator Cape Town puts you in the captain's seat over the real Mother City.

THE REAL CAPE TOWN
Real satellite, elevation and map data: Table Mountain, Lion's Head, Signal Hill and Devil's Peak, the V&A Waterfront, the Zeitz MOCAA silo, the Cape Wheel, Cape Town Stadium, the City Hall, the Castle of Good Hope, the Bo-Kaap and the Green Point lighthouse.

OVER THE TABLETOP
Up through Kloof Nek between Lion's Head and Table Mountain, then low across the flat top past the cableway to Maclear's Beacon.
